absent: Locking and concurrency rules for range table construction, hub info publication, and processor bringup are not shown.
Exact numeric register addresses, shift values, masks, and firmware call contracts are not defined in these fragments.
Allocation lifetime, ownership, and failure recovery beyond diagnostics for working tables and mappings are not shown.
Consumer semantics of consolidated range predecessor links and address translation use are not shown.
Timing, ordering, and error handling for secondary startup delivery and signal completion are not shown.
Validation of firmware supplied counts, bases, and sizes beyond bounds checks shown is not defined.

findings.text: A globally visible per processor initialization hook increments the hub online processor count for application processors while leaving boot processor work to system initialization.

A display bridge state hook ignores non bridge events and commands without input output enabled, otherwise forwards decode request with domain and bus numbers to platform firmware and returns firmware status.

A large system interrupt controller description provides probe plus directed and broadcast signal fanout plus secondary start plus register access and acknowledgement operations with self signaling and register helpers delegated to native extended controller support.
A small parameter record holds four eight bit fields carrying socket width values and shift controls for address decoding.

Range consolidation from firmware entries treats missing source as no operation, validates socket identifiers against known bounds, interprets first gap as memory boundary while reporting later gaps, merges adjacent entries for same socket before boundary and chains later entries through predecessor links, then reduces allocation when shorter.
Secondary start delivers ordered initialization followed by startup requests to node derived from hardware identifier, carrying start address derived vector.
Single destination signaling selects non maskable delivery for the non maskable vector and fixed delivery otherwise, targeting node derived from stored per processor identifier.
Group signaling reuses single destination operation across mask members or online set, with self excluding forms omitting current processor.
Alias redirect scan covers three window pairs.
Low memory remap discovery returns first enabled zero based alias size as power of two with shifted destination base, otherwise zero pair.
High window mapping derives address and span from base shift and node count, skips null base, chooses caching attribute by requested type, and reports resulting interval and segment count.

Accelerator and register window setup prefers newer overlay definition when present else legacy definition, skips mapping with diagnostic when unavailable or firmware disabled, otherwise maps with family appropriate caching and records global range for accelerator.
Memory mapped input output high flavor enumeration uses negative value for legacy family and paired low high values for two newer families where parity identifies window index.

Redirect table interpretation bounds checks node identifiers against expected range, treats out of range as unused without failure, groups consecutive identical nodes for reporting with computed address intervals, and creates direct mapping only for legacy flavor.
High input output window setup selects definition family by register presence in newer to older order, honors per window enable flags, and extracts base and sizing with family specific field access.
Low register mapping conditionally establishes uncached windows for global and local bases only when firmware provides nonzero base.
Clock initialization queries firmware for realtime rate and on failure or implausibly low value warns and uses guessed rate.

Socket geometry derivation starts from zeroed record and firmware width, then applies family specific rules with register read on one older generation and fixed shift choice on another and zeroed values on modern generations, computing complement shift from width.

Hub description initialization fills address masks shifts revisions topology tables and range references, derives node extras and global bases from parsed parameters when available else hardware register, resolves low memory remap, and logs summary.
Parameter block decode retains pointer for later use and logs base shift and address width summary.

Range table walk ends at unused terminator, logs each interval with scaled size and type and identifiers, marks adjusted block sizes, and records entry count plus socket and node minima and maxima plus first gap end magnitude.

System table decode returns immediately for oldest version, disables platform support with error for missing or outdated table, otherwise dispatches parameter and range payloads by type while ignoring architecture type and skipping unknown types with diagnostic.
Blade bound update leaves minima and maxima unchanged for empty mask, otherwise widens them with masked first and last set positions offset by base.
Range table preparation warns once and stops on working allocation failure, skips oversized socket entries with error, and only informs for additional gaps.
Absent or disabled overlay definitions for accelerator register and input output windows skip mapping with diagnostic rather than aborting boot.
Firmware table revision mismatch disables platform mode and reports invalid argument, while unknown entry types are skipped with diagnostic.
Interrupt controller description uses physical destination mode with extended status handling disabled and identifier ceiling at largest unsigned value.
